title: Multimodal Rotary Position (M-RoPE) 3D Coordinate Assignment
seoDescription: Assign time, height, and width coordinates to text, image-grid, separator, and sampled-video segments in one packed sequence.
description:
Assign 3D temporal, vertical, and horizontal spatial coordinates (t, h, w) to interleaved text and image tokens in a multimodal transformer sequence.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
\text{Coord}(x_i) = (t_i, h_i, w_i) \in \mathbb{N}^3
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Identify token modality (text vs image patch).
2. Assign sequential 1D temporal coordinate (pos, 0, 0) to text tokens.
3. Assign 2D spatial grid coordinates (t, row, col) to 2D image patch tokens.
4. Return list of 3D positional coordinate triplets.

**Returns:** List of 3-element coordinate lists [t, h, w].

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Assign 3D temporal, vertical, and horizontal spatial coordinates (t, h, w) to interleaved text and image tokens in a multimodal transformer sequence.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def cs336_l17_multimodal_rope_coordinates(tokens: list, image_grid: list = None) -> list:
    coords, pos = [], 0
    for i in range(len(tokens)):
        if image_grid and i < len(image_grid):
            coords.append(image_grid[i])
        else:
            coords.append([pos, 0, 0])
            pos += 1
    return coords
```
